premise: Little Fish wonders what lies beyond the rock pool; a wave carries him out into the huge sea, and kind Turtle swims beside him back home.
inspiration: The town-mouse-and-country-mouse fable (Aesop) told as a first adventure: the big world is wonderful, and home is still home.
lesson: It's good to explore, and good to come home.

en-US.title: Little Fish and the Big Sea
en-US.text: {seaweed:enter} In the rock pool, beside the swaying fronds of Seaweed, lived {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Little Fish, yellow with two blue stripes. {seaweed:live sway} Seaweed swayed, slow and gentle. {fish:face happy} The pool was cosy. But Little Fish kept wondering: [curious] what's out there? One day {fish:wash 9s} a wave came sloshing in over the rocks. {sfx:slosh solo} And when it went out again, {fish:go to sea} Little Fish went with it! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] The sea was ENORMOUS. {fish:live look-around} Blue on every side, and no edges at all. {fish:live shiver} He felt very, very small. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Then a kind face came gliding up. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} It was Turtle. [warmly] Far from home, little one? I'll swim with you. {turtle:hearts} She swam beside him, slow and steady, until he could see the rocks. {fish:go to pool} Then home he swam. {seaweed:live wave} Seaweed waved her fronds. Welcome back! {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Little Fish wiggled his tail and fluttered his fins. [softly] The sea was wonderful. But the pool was home.

es-ES.title: El pececito y el mar grande
es-ES.text: {seaweed:enter} En la charca, junto a las frondas de Alga, vivía {fish:enter} {fish:go to pool} Pececito, amarillo con dos rayas azules. {seaweed:live sway} Alga se mecía, despacio y suave. {fish:face happy} La charca era acogedora. Pero Pececito no paraba de preguntarse: [curious] ¿qué habrá ahí fuera? Un día, {fish:wash 9s} una ola entró chapoteando por encima de las rocas. {sfx:slosh solo} Y cuando volvió a salir, {fish:go to sea} ¡Pececito se fue con ella! {fish:face surprised} [in awe] El mar era ENORME. {fish:live look-around} Azul por todas partes, y sin bordes por ningún lado. {fish:live shiver} Se sintió muy, muy pequeño. {fish:face sad} [short pause] Entonces se acercó una cara amable, deslizándose. {turtle:enter by swim} {turtle:go to fish by swim} Era Tortuga. [warmly] ¿Tan lejos de casa, pequeño? Yo nado contigo. {turtle:hearts} Nadó a su lado, despacio y sin parar, hasta que se vieron las rocas. {fish:go to pool} Y entonces Pececito volvió nadando a casa. {seaweed:live wave} Alga movió sus frondas. ¡Bienvenido! {fish:face happy} {fish:live wiggle} Pececito meneó la cola y agitó las aletas. [softly] El mar era maravilloso. Pero la charca era su casa.

ja-JP.title: おさかなくんと 大きな海
ja-JP.text: {seaweed:enter}海藻がゆれる潮だまりに、{fish:enter}{fish:go to pool}おさかなくんがすんでいました。きいろに、青いしまが二本。{seaweed:live sway}海藻は、ゆーらり、ゆーらり。{fish:face happy}いごこちのいい、おうちです。でも、おさかなくんは、いつもおもっていました。[curious]そとには、なにがあるのかな？ある日、{fish:wash 9s}波が、岩をこえて、ざぶーん！{sfx:slosh solo}その波がひいていくと…{fish:go to sea}おさかなくんも、いっしょにながされてしまいました！{fish:face surprised}[in awe]海は、とーっても大きい！{fish:live look-around}どっちを見ても、青、青、青。はしっこなんて、ありません。{fish:live shiver}じぶんが、ちっちゃく、ちっちゃく、かんじます。{fish:face sad}[short pause]そのとき、やさしい顔が、すうっとちかづいてきました。{turtle:enter by swim}{turtle:go to fish by swim}ウミガメさんです。[warmly]「おうちからとおいのね、ぼうや。いっしょに、およぎましょう」 {turtle:hearts}となりを、ゆっくり、ゆっくり、およいでくれます。岩が見えてくるまで。{fish:go to pool}おさかなくんは、潮だまりへ、すいすい。{seaweed:live wave}海藻が、ゆらゆら手をふります。「おかえり！」 {fish:face happy}{fish:live wiggle}おさかなくんは、しっぽをぴちぴち、ひれをひらひら。[softly]海は、すばらしかった。でも、おうちは、やっぱり潮だまり。
